checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事はヨシュア記11:17・12:7・13:5の町として特定し、ヘルモン山麓と説明する一方、正確な位置には複数説を示す。

geographyAssessmentJa: 本文の谷間の町として候補表示は可能。記事も正確な比定を未確定とするため、単一確定地として見せない。
